detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:03. The shot begins from <Picture 3>: a medium shot along the horsehair sofa: <Subject 1> lies along the buttoned black seat under a brown rug, bare-headed, dark hair swept back, his bottle-green velvet sleeve along his side, his stockinged heels at the LEFT edge and his pale face on the rolled arm at the RIGHT at a sixth of the frame's height, the drawn heavy red curtain behind his head, low amber gaslight lying along the buttoned seat. The camera is on the red Turkey carpet at the room's centre, chest height above the seat, eight feet out, a 40mm lens square across the sofa. The sofa runs from the LEFT edge of frame to the RIGHT edge. The camera pushes in a stride along the sofa toward his head at the RIGHT as <Subject 1>'s chest rises once under the brown rug, a thumb's width, from 00:00 to 00:03. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:03 while his chest rises once under the brown rug.
[Shot 2] From 00:03 to 00:08. At 00:03 the shot cuts to an insert along the buttoned black seat, beginning from <Picture 4>: <Subject 1>'s two stockinged heels lie together at the CENTRE of frame, each heel a fist wide, the brown rug's hem across the ankles a hand above them, the violin's tailpiece and the bow's frog beyond them at his hip, low amber gaslight in stripes along the black horsehair; only what <Picture 4> shows is in frame. The camera is on the red Turkey carpet at the room's centre, a hand above the seat, three feet from the heels at the foot end of the sofa, a 50mm lens turned square along the cushion. The two stockinged heels keep the CENTRE of frame. At the first frame Holmes's two stockinged heels lie together on the buttoned black seat at the CENTRE of frame. The camera pushes in a hand's breadth along the seat toward the rug's hem as one stockinged toe turns a quarter turn on the buttoned black seat, from 00:03 to 00:08.
